packageRules.description: Pin GitHub Actions to digests so the OpenSSF Scorecard pinned-dependencies check stays satisfied. The digest-maintenance PRs are batched into the weekly group below.
Collapse every non-major update (minor, patch, digest, pin) into ONE weekly batched PR so PR volume stays low. Majors and security alerts are handled separately below.
Major updates stay individual and manually reviewed (no automerge), and are not delayed to the weekly window.
